title: A Unifying Framework for Robust and Efficient Inference with Unstructured Data
abstract: arXiv:2505.00282v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: AI can cheaply extract structured variables from unstructured data, with alternative implementation choices potentially yielding different measures of the same concept. This creates a credibility challenge, effectively moving specification search upstream. We confront this challenge with MAR-S (Missing At Random Structured Data), a framework which adapts semiparametric missing data theory to deliver valid, efficient, robust inference with AI predictions. MAR-S anchors measurement in a transparent validation sample design, while AI scales measurement. We provide general recipes for MAR-S estimation and extend the framework to aggregated and transformed AI predictions, a common setting not addressed by existing frameworks.

translated_title: 一个用于非结构化数据稳健高效推断的统一框架
translated_abstract: AI可以低成本地从非结构化数据中提取结构化变量，但不同的实现选择可能会对同一概念产生不同的度量结果。这带来了可信度方面的挑战，实际上将设定搜索问题转移到了上游环节。我们提出MAR-S（随机缺失结构化数据）框架来应对这一挑战，该框架借鉴半参数缺失数据理论，以实现基于AI预测的有效、高效且稳健的推断。MAR-S将测量锚定在透明的验证样本设计之上，同时利用AI来规模化测量。我们提供了MAR-S估计的通用方法，并将该框架扩展到聚合和转换后的AI预测场景，这是现有框架尚未解决的常见问题。
tldr: 该论文提出MAR-S框架，将半参数缺失数据理论应用于AI预测，通过透明的验证样本设计实现非结构化数据下有效、高效且稳健的推断，并首次将框架扩展到聚合和转换后的AI预测这一常见但未被现有方法覆盖的场景。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MAR-S, a framework that adapts semiparametric missing data theory to deliver valid, efficient, and robust inference with AI predictions on unstructured data, and extends it to aggregated and transformed AI predictions—a common setting not addressed by existing frameworks.
